info.title: RMS Backend API
info.description:
API documentation for the Restaurant Management System.

## Real-Time Notifications (WebSockets)
This backend uses **Socket.IO** for real-time updates. Since Swagger only documents HTTP endpoints, here is the guide to connecting to the notification system:

### 1. Connection & Authentication
Clients must connect using `socket.io-client` and provide their JWT Access Token in the handshake:
```javascript
import { io } from "socket.io-client";

const socket = io("YOUR_BACKEND_URL", {
  auth: { token: "your_access_token_here" }
});
```

### 2. Sub-Rooms (Namespaces)
By default, you are placed in a global room for your restaurant. You can also join specific views:
- `socket.emit("join:kitchen")`
- `socket.emit("join:floor")`
- `socket.emit("join:cashier")`

### 3. Events to Listen For
- `order.updated` - Broadcast when an order is created, modified, confirmed, or voided.
- `kot.updated` - Broadcast to the `kitchen` room when KOTs are fired or their statuses change.
- `table.updated` - Broadcast to the `floor` room when tables are occupied, released, or merged.
- `bill.updated` - Broadcast to the `cashier` room when a bill is generated or paid.
- `payment.updated` - Broadcast to the `cashier` room for new payments or voids.
- `stock.updated` - Broadcast globally when inventory levels drop to update frontend menus.

post.description: Authenticates a user and returns a short-lived access token (15 min) and a long-lived refresh token (7 days). The access token is used as a Bearer token for API requests. The refresh token should be stored securely and used with POST /auth/refresh to obtain new token pairs.

200.description: Login successful — returns access and refresh token pair

refreshToken.description: Long-lived JWT for obtaining new token pairs (default: 7 days)

post.description: Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access + refresh token pair (token rotation). The old refresh token is revoked immediately. If a previously revoked refresh token is presented (replay attack), the entire token family is invalidated for security.

post.description: Revokes the provided refresh token, ending the session on the current device. Does not require authentication — the refresh token itself serves as proof of session ownership.

get.description: List all tables. If tables are part of a combine group, they are returned as a single merged table where `id` is an array of all combined table UUIDs, `name` is concatenated, and `capacity` is summed. Uncombined tables also return their `id` as a single-element array for consistency.

List all occupied tables. If tables are part of a combine group, they are returned as a single merged table where `id` is an array of all combined table UUIDs, `name` is concatenated, and `capacity` is summed. Uncombined tables also return their `id` as a single-element array for consistency.

post.description: Release a table (sets status to AVAILABLE and clears its active order). The previously seated order retains its tableId for historical reporting — so it is no longer linked to any table. If the table is part of an active combine group, the entire combine group is automatically dissolved and all associated tables are released simultaneously.

post.summary: Seat an order on a table (create new or attach existing)

schema.description: Provide `orderId` to attach an existing order to this table; omit it to create a new dine-in order seated at the table.

orderId.description: Attach mode: re-seat this existing order at the table (moves it if it was elsewhere).

customerId.description: Create mode only. UUID of an existing registered Customer (from the /customers API) for tracking loyalty/history. If the customer is a walk-in and you don't want to create a CRM record, omit this and use 'customerName' instead.

customerName.description: Create mode only. Free-text string (e.g., 'John Doe') to label the order for a quick walk-in guest without creating a permanent CRM customer record. Mutually exclusive in practice with customerId.

items.description: Create mode only. Order line items.

courseName.description: Optional KDS course label, e.g. Starters, Mains, Desserts. Can be fired later via POST /kot/orders/{orderId}/fire.

fireAt.description: Optional delayed-fire timestamp. Future values hold this line out of immediate KOT generation until manually fired or due.

201.description: Order seated at the table (table marked OCCUPIED and bound to the order).

409.description: Table already has an active order, or the order cannot be edited

post.description: Bidirectional table ⇄ order seating from the table side. Attach mode (`orderId` present) re-seats an existing order at this table. Create mode (no `orderId`) starts a fresh dine-in order already seated here. In both cases the table is marked OCCUPIED and its activeOrderId is set to the order.

Move an active order from one table to another. The orderId is automatically derived from the source table's active order — you only need to provide the two table IDs. The source table is released and the target table is occupied with the order.

fromTableId.description: The table currently holding the order

toTableId.description: The target table to move the order to

400.description: Bad Request — cannot swap table with itself, guest count exceeds capacity

404.description: Source table, target table, or order not found

409.description: Conflict — source table has no active order, target table not available, cancelled/voided order

post.description: Combine 2–10 tables into a group. Any mix of OCCUPIED and AVAILABLE tables is valid. When occupied tables are combined, a NEW order is created with all items merged from all occupied tables' orders. Old orders are marked COMPLETED with `mergedIntoOrderId` linking them to the new merged order for search/history. If all tables are available, an empty CONFIRMED order is created. The backend automatically detects which tables are occupied, fetches their orders, creates the merged order, and handles everything — the frontend only needs to send tableIds. Releasing any table in the group auto-dissolves the entire group.

tableIds.description: 2–10 table IDs. Any combination of OCCUPIED and AVAILABLE tables.

201.description: Combine group created with merged order

previousOrders.description: Old orders that were merged (COMPLETED). Empty if all tables were available.

400.description: Bad Request — duplicate IDs, non-DINE_IN order

409.description: Conflict — table under maintenance, already in a group, order has paid bill, cancelled/voided order

post.description: Split Table (Physical Move). Split specific order items (full or partial quantity) from an occupied source table's order into a new order on a completely different, available target table. A new CONFIRMED order is created with the split items, KOT is generated, and the target table is occupied. If all items are split, the source order is auto-cancelled and the source table is released. Cannot split from a table that is part of an active combine group.

sourceOrderId.description: The active order on the source table. Backend resolves the source table from this order.

quantity.description: Quantity to split (must be ≤ available quantity)

sourceOrder.description: The source order after split (updated totals)

newOrder.description: The newly created order on the target table

400.description: Bad Request — same table, quantity exceeds available, not DINE_IN

404.description: Table, order, or order items not found

409.description: Conflict — source not occupied, target not available, part of combine group, cancelled/voided order

get.description: Lists stock for the current backend business date. After the 4 AM reset, this also creates missing stock rows for tracked menu items and variants with a new stock id and zero opening quantity.

post.description: Creates opening stock for the current backend business date. The client does not send businessDate; the backend injects it from the 4 AM business-day reset.

patch.description: Updates opening quantity and low-stock alert for the current backend business date using menuItemId and optional variantId. This does not update previous business-day stock.
Adjusts only the current backend business-day stock row by id. Use openingQty when production changes, remainingQty for a physical stock correction, and lowStockAt for alert changes.

get.description: Returns only orders created in the last 24 hours (rolling window), ordered newest-first. Older orders are not returned by this endpoint.

post.description: Creates an order. For a DINE_IN order with a tableId, the table is seated atomically (status set to OCCUPIED and linked as its active order). Returns 409 if that table already has an active order or is under maintenance. On success the response `data` includes `kitchenPrinterJobs`: one payload per kitchen station involved in the order, each carrying that station's printer IP/port and ONLY its own items. The backend never talks to printers — the frontend reads this and prints.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Replay-safe key. Same key + route returns the original response.

schema.description: Create an order. Every field is optional — an empty body creates an empty DINE_IN order. For TAKEAWAY/DELIVERY set channel and do NOT send tableId.

channel.description: Optional, defaults to DINE_IN. DINE_IN orders may carry a tableId; TAKEAWAY/DELIVERY must not (validation error if they do).

tableId.description: Optional. DINE_IN only. If provided, the new order is seated at this table in the same transaction: the table is set to OCCUPIED and bound as its active order. Omit it to leave the order unseated (seat later via PATCH /orders/{id} or POST /tables/{id}/order). Returns 409 if the table already has another active order or is under maintenance.

customerId.description: Optional. UUID of an existing registered Customer (from the /customers API) for tracking loyalty/history. If the customer is a walk-in and you don't want to create a CRM record, omit this and use 'customerName' instead.

customerName.description: Optional. Free-text string (e.g., 'John Doe') to label the order for a quick walk-in guest without creating a permanent CRM customer record. Use this instead of customerId for fast rush-hour orders.

specialInstructions.description: Optional. Free-text note for the whole order (max 500 chars).

items.description: Optional. Order line items; defaults to an empty list (items can be added later).

courseName.description: Optional KDS course label, e.g. Starters, Mains, Desserts. Can be fired later via POST /kot/orders/{orderId}/fire.

fireAt.description: Optional delayed-fire timestamp. Future values hold this line out of immediate KOT generation until manually fired or due.

data.description: The order plus kitchen printer routing.

kitchenPrinterJobs.description: One job per kitchen station in the order. Each carries the station's printer IP/port and only that station's items. Backend prepares routing only; the frontend connects to the printer and prints the KOT.

patch.description: Adds items to an order. Items in the `items` array are **add-ons** to the existing order: an item already on the order (same dish + variant + note + addons) increments its quantity, while anything else becomes a new line. Existing lines absent from the body are left unchanged — a PATCH never cancels food already on the order. On success the response `data` includes `kitchenPrinterJobs` for the lines fired to the kitchen by this edit (add-on items); empty when nothing new was fired.

schema.description: Items to add to the order. Each requested line either matches an existing line (increment its quantity) or is new (create a new line). Existing lines absent from the body are left exactly as they are — a PATCH never cancels food already on the order.

items.description: Items to ADD to the order. Each line either increments an existing matching line (same dish + variant + note + addons) or creates a new add-on line. Existing lines not in this array are left unchanged.

courseName.description: Optional KDS course label, e.g. Starters, Mains, Desserts. Can be fired later via POST /kot/orders/{orderId}/fire.

fireAt.description: Optional delayed-fire timestamp. Future values hold this line out of immediate KOT generation until manually fired or due.

get.description:
Generates enterprise-grade analytics reports. The response shape varies by report type.

**Important**: `byHour` data is only included when `resolution` is `day` or `week`.

**Available report types:**
- **`sales`**: Revenue analytics with period comparison, staff/channel/hourly breakdown
- **`items`**: Item analytics with top/bottom sellers, never-ordered items, category breakdown
- **`staff`**: Comprehensive staff performance: orders, revenue, cancellation rates, fulfillment speed, payment collections, accountability, top items
- **`orders`**: Order lifecycle analytics with cancellation rates, fulfillment time, channel breakdown
- **`payments`**: Payment analytics with method breakdown (% share), net revenue, staff collections
- **`inventory`**: Stock status for a business date with category breakdown and critical alerts
- **`audit`**: Audit trail analytics by action, entity, staff, and time
- **`profit`**: Profitability analytics with margin %, COGS, by category and item
- **`dashboard`**: Composite executive dashboard combining sales, orders, inventory, staff, and profit

get.description:
Exports any report in the requested format. All sensitive data (passwords, tokens, internal IDs) is automatically stripped before export.

**Formats:**
- **csv** — Sectioned flat file with labeled headers (SUMMARY, DETAILS, TRENDS, etc.), formula-injection guarded, RFC-4180 compliant.
- **pdf** — Professional A4 document with styled title header, summary KPIs, bordered data tables with alternating row shading, trend data, comparison breakdowns, auto-pagination, and CONFIDENTIAL footer.
- **excel** — Multi-sheet Excel workbook (.xlsx) with sheets: Report Info, Summary, Details, Trends, plus one sheet per comparison breakdown. Auto-sized columns with humanized headers.

**Frontend Integration:**
- You MUST set responseType blob in your HTTP client (axios/fetch). Without this, binary formats (PDF, Excel) will be corrupted.
- The response includes a Content-Disposition header with the filename (e.g. payments-report.xlsx). Parse it to get the correct filename.
- Example (axios): axios.get(url, { responseType: blob }) then create a download link from URL.createObjectURL(response.data).
- Example (fetch): fetch(url).then(r => r.blob()) then trigger download via anchor element.

get.description: Returns the company's **singleton** inventory settings document (costing, stock and alert policies). May be `null` until first saved. Requires `inventory:read`.

200.description: Success — settings object (or null if never set)

patch.description:
Upserts the company's singleton inventory settings (creates the row if none exists). All fields are **optional** — only the keys you send are changed; omitted keys keep their current value. Requires `inventory:write`.

**Editable fields:** `allowNegativeStock`, `defaultCostingMethod`, `defaultVatRate`, `lowStockAlertEnabled`, `expiryAlertEnabled`, `expiryAlertDays`.

allowNegativeStock.description: If true, stock-outs may drive a balance negative; if false, posting fails when stock is insufficient.

defaultCostingMethod.description: Default costing method applied to new items.

expiryAlertDays.description: Days before expiry to start alerting.

get.description: Paginated list of measurement units (excludes soft-deleted). Each unit includes its conversions. Requires `inventory:read`.

200.description: Paginated units in `data`, page info in `meta`

post.description:
Creates a measurement unit. `createdById` is taken from the token (not client-supplied). Requires `inventory:write`.

**Note on Duplicates**: If a unit with the same name already exists but was previously soft-deleted, it will be seamlessly restored and updated with the new details instead of failing. If it's an active unit, a 409 Conflict will be thrown.

**Editable fields:** `name`, `symbol`, `type`, `isBaseUnit`.

get.description: Returns a single non-deleted unit. Requires `inventory:read`.

patch.description:
Partial update — send only the fields to change. Requires `inventory:write`.

**Editable fields:** `name`, `symbol`, `type`, `isBaseUnit`, `isActive`.
**Not editable:** `id`, `createdById`, timestamps (server-managed).

delete.description: **Dynamic delete**: If the unit has relations (e.g. used in items), performs a **Soft delete** (sets `isDeleted = true`, `isActive = false`, and scrambles the name to free up unique constraints). If no relations exist, performs a **Hard delete**. Requires `inventory:write`.

post.description: Defines a conversion factor so quantities can be converted between two units (`1 fromUnit = factor × toUnit`). The reverse direction is derived automatically (factor inverted) at lookup time. `fromUnitId` and `toUnitId` must differ. Requires `inventory:write`.

patch.description: Partial update for a unit conversion. You can modify the `factor` or change the linked units. Requires `inventory:write`.

get.description: Paginated list of inventory items (excludes soft-deleted). Each item includes its base unit, category and current stock balance. Requires `inventory:read`.

200.description: Paginated items in `data`, page info in `meta`

post.description:
Creates an inventory item. `createdById` comes from the token. Stock balance is created later by posting a purchase/adjustment — not here. Requires `inventory:write`.

**Editable fields:** `name`, `code`, `type`, `categoryId`, `baseUnitId`, `reorderLevel`, `trackExpiry`, `costingMethod`, `defaultPurchasePrice`.

baseUnitId.description: Base stocking unit; all quantities are stored in this unit.

409.description: Conflict (duplicate code)

get.description: Returns a single non-deleted item with base unit, category and stock balance. Requires `inventory:read`.

patch.description:
Partial update — send only the fields to change. Requires `inventory:write`.

**Editable fields:** `name`, `code`, `type`, `categoryId`, `baseUnitId`, `reorderLevel`, `trackExpiry`, `costingMethod`, `defaultPurchasePrice`, `isActive`.
**Not editable:** `id`, `createdById`, and the derived `stockBalance` (changed only by posting purchases/stock-outs/adjustments).
**Caution:** changing `baseUnitId` after stock movements exist can mis-scale historical quantities.

defaultPurchasePrice.description: Monetary value (accepts number or numeric string); non-negative

409.description: Conflict (duplicate code)

**Editable fields:** `name`, `phone`, `email`, `address`, `panNumber`, `vatNumber`, `contactPerson`.

**Editable fields:** `name`, `phone`, `email`, `address`, `panNumber`, `vatNumber`, `contactPerson`, `isActive`.
**Not editable:** `id`, `createdById`, timestamps.

delete.description: **Dynamic delete**: If the supplier has relations (e.g. used in purchases), performs a **Soft delete** (sets `isDeleted = true`, `isActive = false`, and scrambles the name). If no relations exist, performs a **Hard delete**. Requires `inventory:write`.

get.description: Paginated list of purchases with supplier and line items. Requires `inventory:read`.

200.description: Paginated purchases in `data`, page info in `meta`

post.description:
Creates a purchase in **`DRAFT`** status with at least one line item. Stock is **not** affected until you post it (`POST /inventory/purchases/{id}/post`). Requires `inventory:write`.

**Editable header fields:** `supplierId`, `supplierInvoiceNumber`, `purchaseDate`, `discount`, `vatRate`, `note`.
**Editable line fields:** `itemId`, `unitId`, `quantity`, `unitCost`, `batchNumber`, `manufacturedDate`, `expiryDate`.
**Server-computed (returned, do not send):** `purchaseNumber` (auto `PUR-…`), `status` (`DRAFT`), `subtotal`, `vatAmount`, `grandTotal`; per line `baseQuantity` (converted to base unit) and `total` (= quantity × unitCost).

**Lifecycle:** `DRAFT → PATCH to edit → POST to post → POST to cancel`. While in `DRAFT` status, the purchase can be freely edited via `PATCH /inventory/purchases/{id}`. Once `POSTED`, stock movements are created and editing is locked; use `POST /inventory/purchases/{id}/cancel` to reverse.

**Discount:** Use `discount` object with `type` and `value`.
**VAT Rate:** If not provided, defaults to company tax config (or 13% if no config).

discount.description: Discount object with type and value.

vatRate.description: VAT % applied to (subtotal − discount). Optional; defaults to company tax config or 13% if not provided.

unitId.description: Unit the quantity is expressed in; converted to the item base unit on save.

unitCost.description: Monetary value (accepts number or numeric string); non-negative

get.description: Returns a purchase with supplier and line items (item + unit). Requires `inventory:read`.

patch.description:
Partially updates a **DRAFT** purchase. All fields are optional; only send what changed. If `items` is provided, the **entire line-item set is replaced** (old items are deleted and new ones created atomically). Financial totals (`subtotal`, `vatAmount`, `grandTotal`) are **always recalculated** server-side.

Requires `inventory:write`.

**Status guard:** Returns **409** if the purchase is not in `DRAFT` status. Posted or cancelled purchases cannot be edited.

**Discount:** Use `discount` object with `type` and `value`.

supplierId.description: Set to null to clear the supplier.

discount.description: Discount object with type and value.

vatRate.description: VAT % applied to (subtotal − discount). Optional; defaults to company tax config or 13% if not provided.

items.description: If provided, completely replaces all existing line items. Must contain at least 1 item.

unitId.description: Unit the quantity is expressed in; converted to the item base unit on save.

400.description: Bad Request (validation failed, e.g. both discount fields set)

409.description: Only DRAFT purchases can be edited

post.description:
Commits a `DRAFT` purchase and updates stock. **No request body.** Requires `inventory:write`.

**Lifecycle:** `DRAFT → POSTED`. Only a `DRAFT` purchase can be posted; a `POSTED`/`CANCELLED` one returns **409**.

**Effect on post:**
- Sets `status = POSTED`, `postedById`, `postedAt`.
- Increases each item's `StockBalance.quantityOnHand` by the line `baseQuantity`.
- Recomputes the weighted-average cost (`totalValue / quantityOnHand`).
- Creates a `StockBatch` per line (for FIFO/FEFO costing and expiry tracking).
- Records a `PURCHASE_IN` stock movement per line.

**Note:** Posted purchases can later be cancelled via `POST /inventory/purchases/{id}/cancel`, which fully reverses all stock effects.

409.description: Only DRAFT purchases can be posted

post.description:
Cancels a `DRAFT` or `POSTED` purchase. Requires `inventory:write`.

**For DRAFT purchases:** Simply sets `status = CANCELLED`. No stock effects to reverse.

**For POSTED purchases:** Fully reverses all stock effects in an atomic transaction:
- Decreases each item's `StockBalance.quantityOnHand` by the line `baseQuantity`.
- Recomputes the weighted-average cost.
- Sets `remainingQty = 0` on all related `StockBatch` records.
- Creates a reversal `StockMovement` per line (type: `PURCHASE_IN`, direction: `OUT`).
- Respects the `allowNegativeStock` setting — returns **409** if reversal would cause negative stock and negative stock is not allowed.

**Terminal state:** Once cancelled, a purchase cannot be edited, posted, or cancelled again (returns **409**).

200.description: Cancelled purchase with updated status and cancellation metadata

409.description: Purchase is already cancelled, or cancellation would cause negative stock

get.description: Paginated list of stock-outs with line items. Requires `inventory:read`.

200.description: Paginated stock-outs in `data`, page info in `meta`

post.description:
Creates a stock-out (consumption/wastage) in **`DRAFT`** status with at least one line item. Stock is **not** affected until you post it. Requires `inventory:write`.

**Editable header fields:** `reason`, `customReason`, `stockOutDate`, `issuedTo`, `receivedBy`, `note`.
**Editable line fields:** `itemId`, `unitId`, `quantity`, `note`.
**Server-computed (returned, do not send):** `stockOutNumber` (auto `OUT-…`), `status` (`DRAFT`); per line `baseQuantity`.

**Immutable after creation:** there is no update or delete endpoint for this document. While `DRAFT` the only action is posting; once `POSTED` it is final. Re-create a new document if changes are needed before posting.

customReason.description: Free-text detail, typically used with reason OTHER.

unitId.description: Unit the quantity is expressed in; converted to the item base unit on save.

get.description: Returns a stock-out with line items (item + unit). Requires `inventory:read`.

post.description:
Commits a `DRAFT` stock-out and deducts stock. **No request body.** **Irreversible** via the API. Requires `inventory:write`.

**Lifecycle:** `DRAFT → POSTED`. Only a `DRAFT` stock-out can be posted (else **409**).

**Effect on post:**
- Sets `status = POSTED`, `postedById`, `postedAt`.
- Decreases each item's `StockBalance.quantityOnHand` by the line `baseQuantity`, valued at the current average cost.
- Records a `STOCK_OUT` (direction `OUT`) movement per line.

**Negative-stock guard** (inventory setting `allowNegativeStock`):
- `false` (default): **409** if no balance exists or available < requested.
- `true`: deduction proceeds and may drive the balance negative.

409.description: Not DRAFT, or insufficient stock when negative stock is disallowed

get.description: Paginated list of stock adjustments with line items. Requires `inventory:read`.

200.description: Paginated adjustments in `data`, page info in `meta`

post.description:
Creates a stock adjustment (physical-count reconciliation) in **`DRAFT`** status with at least one line item. Stock is **not** affected until you post it. Requires `inventory:write`.

**Editable header fields:** `reason`, `adjustmentDate`, `note`.
**Editable line fields:** `itemId`, `unitId`, `actualQuantity`, `note` — you send only the **counted** quantity.
**Server-computed (returned, do not send):** `adjustmentNumber` (auto `ADJ-…`), `status` (`DRAFT`); per line `systemQuantity`, `differenceQuantity`, `baseSystemQuantity`, `baseActualQuantity`, `baseDifferenceQuantity` (snapshot of the current balance vs your count).

**After creation:** While in `DRAFT` you can edit via `PATCH /adjustments/{id}`, delete via `DELETE /adjustments/{id}`, or post via `POST /adjustments/{id}/post`. Once `POSTED`, only cancellation is available via `POST /adjustments/{id}/cancel`.

unitId.description: Unit the counted quantity is expressed in; converted to base unit on save.

actualQuantity.description: Physically counted quantity. The system stores the current system quantity and computes the difference; you only send what you counted.

get.description: Returns an adjustment with line items (item + unit), cancel info, and actor details. Requires `inventory:read`.

patch.description:
Partially updates a **DRAFT** adjustment. All fields are optional; only send what changed. If `items` is provided, the **entire line-item set is replaced** — old items are deleted and new ones created atomically with fresh system-quantity snapshots.

Requires `inventory:write`.

**Status guard:** Returns **409** if the adjustment is not in `DRAFT` status. Posted or cancelled adjustments cannot be edited.

**System quantity refresh:** When items are replaced, the server re-fetches current `StockBalance` quantities (they may have changed since the draft was created) and recalculates `systemQuantity`, `differenceQuantity`, and all base equivalents.

items.description: If provided, completely replaces all existing line items. Must contain at least 1 item. System quantities are re-fetched from current stock balances.

unitId.description: Unit the counted quantity is expressed in; converted to base unit on save.

200.description: Updated adjustment with recalculated system quantities and differences

409.description: Only DRAFT adjustments can be edited

delete.description:
Hard-deletes a **DRAFT** adjustment and all its line items. Requires `inventory:write`.

**Status guard:** Returns **409** if the adjustment is not in `DRAFT` status. Only drafts can be deleted — use cancel for posted adjustments.

409.description: Only DRAFT adjustments can be deleted

post.description:
Commits a `DRAFT` adjustment, reconciling stock to the counted quantities. **No request body.** Requires `inventory:write`.

**Lifecycle:** `DRAFT → POSTED`. Only a `DRAFT` adjustment can be posted (else **409**).

**Effect on post:**
- Sets `status = POSTED`, `postedById`, `postedAt`.
- **Sets** each item's `StockBalance.quantityOnHand` to the counted `baseActualQuantity` (absolute set, not a delta); `totalValue` is recomputed as `actualQty × averageCost`.
- Records an `ADJUSTMENT_IN` movement when the count is higher than the system quantity, or `ADJUSTMENT_OUT` when lower.

**Note:** Posted adjustments can later be cancelled via `POST /inventory/adjustments/{id}/cancel`, which fully reverses all stock effects.

409.description: Only DRAFT adjustments can be posted

post.description:
Cancels a `DRAFT` or `POSTED` adjustment. Requires `inventory:write`.

**For DRAFT adjustments:** Simply sets `status = CANCELLED`. No stock effects to reverse.

**For POSTED adjustments:** Fully reverses all stock effects in an atomic transaction:
- For each line, reverses the `baseDifferenceQuantity`: if the original adjustment added stock (positive diff), the reversal subtracts it; if it removed stock (negative diff), the reversal adds it back.
- Recomputes `StockBalance.quantityOnHand` and `totalValue`.
- Creates a reversal `StockMovement` per line (`ADJUSTMENT_OUT` for positive diffs, `ADJUSTMENT_IN` for negative diffs).

**Terminal state:** Once cancelled, an adjustment cannot be edited, posted, or cancelled again (returns **409**).

200.description: Cancelled adjustment with updated status and cancellation metadata

409.description: Adjustment is already cancelled
